title: LIME-style Local Linear Explanation
learning_objectives: Perturb an instance with binary feature masks
Weight samples by proximity with an exponential kernel
Fit a weighted linear model and read local coefficients
entry_point: sample_masks(n, d, rng); lime_explain(predict, x, baseline, masks, kernel_width=0.75)
hints: Inputs: `Xz = masks * x + (1 - masks) * baseline`; `y = predict(Xz)`.
`A = np.column_stack([ones, masks]) * sqrt(w)[:, None]`; `beta = lstsq(A, y * sqrt(w))`.

failure_feedback.advice: Fit on the binary masks (with intercept), not on the raw perturbed inputs.
D = fraction of features removed; weight = exp(−D²/σ²).
Row 0 is all ones; other rows are rng.random((n−1, d)) < 0.5.
Scale both the design rows and targets by sqrt(weight) before lstsq.
